item.title: Rewriting Reality: The Information War That Defined 2025 - PCIJ.org
item.description: There were nearly no slow news days in 2025. The year was a high-pressure firehose of events that left the public scavenging for information. High news demand provided the perfect cover for foreign and domestic actors to plant manipulated narratives online. The goal: to distort public perception of the news.
